explicitLimits: No proof of actual OS/browser scheduler freeze or discard from synthetic fixtures.
priorRound.sequencingDecision: Under canonical Personal-Forge Policy B, the human review is local and does not block independent reversible LONG-CHAT-PERF work. Final certification must surface the deferred question.

roundHypotheses.claim: Long-conversation cost may be dominated by repeated full-DOM selector enumeration even though answer post-processing is capped at ANSWER_SCAN_LIMIT=48.
roundHypotheses.repositoryBasis: _collectAnswerCandidates calls document.querySelectorAll for every assistant selector before slicing the last 48 matches; ChatGPT currently has three assistant selectors. engineTick calls Adapter.getLastText every 2500ms while RUNNING.

roundHypotheses.claim: Dispatch confirmation may duplicate long-chat DOM work because _sendEvidence measures _qAll(PLAT.assistant).length and Adapter.getLastText while the send journal is unresolved.
roundHypotheses.repositoryBasis: _beginSendAttempt and _sendEvidence both collect assistant state; any optimization must preserve at-most-once Send evidence and must not trade correctness for speed.

roundHypotheses.claim: Rendering, MutationObserver churn, platform-specific virtual scrolling, or other DOM work may dominate instead of answer scanning.
roundHypotheses.repositoryBasis: The round must measure competing hot paths before choosing a fix; the existing lifecycle mobile fixture with 180 messages is not a long-chat performance certification.

dispatch.instruction: Claim R5-A1-LONGCHAT-BASELINE regardless of timer number. Establish reproducible long-chat hot-path evidence before production optimization.

assignments.goal: Establish an exact-head long-conversation performance/correctness baseline, identify the dominant hot path, and compare materially different optimization philosophies before any production change.
assignments.rationale: Current answer selection caps post-processing to 48 candidates but still enumerates complete selector match sets; engineTick polls every 2.5s, and send confirmation performs additional assistant scans. The dominant cost must be measured rather than assumed.
assignments.mandatoryAction: Use repository evidence plus current authoritative performance/testing sources and relevant real-user/community evidence when available. Resolve at least two opposing implementation philosophies and one outside-frame candidate. Convert each claim into a measurable prediction.
candidateApproaches: Expert A / bounded-polling minimalist: preserve the current polling architecture and reduce hot-path work with tail-aware lookup, selector consolidation, cache validation, or other small read-only optimizations.

Expert B / event-driven incremental observer: track the newest assistant-turn candidate through mutation events and use polling primarily as validation/recovery, accepting additional state complexity only if measurements justify it.

Outside-frame candidate: reduce dependence on repeated conversation-DOM scanning through a portable observation signal or platform adapter capability, but reject any design that grants network telemetry or heuristics new Send authority.
prohibitedActions: production optimization before a reproduced baseline
inventing a millisecond budget after seeing results
acceptanceCriteria: Create a deterministic long-chat fixture using the real userscript path at multiple conversation sizes, including the existing 180-message reference and materially larger histories such as 500, 1000, and 2000 assistant turns where CI capacity permits
Measure per-operation or per-tick timing plus query/scan counts for answer selection, send-observation assistant counting, rendering or observer work when relevant, and record DOM size
Verify newest-answer and terminal-marker correctness with older terminal markers, nested duplicates, hidden duplicates, and an unfinished newest response
Record p50/p95 or an equivalent distribution across repeated samples; compare scaling trends before selecting an optimization
Gather primary/upstream/adoption evidence and real user/community evidence when it can discriminate between approaches; mark unavailable evidence UNKNOWN rather than inventing sentiment
Predeclare candidate comparison criteria and identify the smallest fix whose predicted improvement can be falsified
No lifecycle/performance measurement may actuate Send or change actuator authority
requiredTests: focused Jest or Playwright long-chat baseline fixture on exact branch head
existing answer-selection correctness tests relevant to newest-answer semantics
record exact command/head/run/job/artifact when CI is used
requiredEvidence: recommended smallest next implementation and falsification criterion
assignments.fallbackWork: If browser execution is unavailable, commit the deterministic benchmark/correctness fixture and exact execution command, mark A1 blocked only on execution, and activate a bounded A1X exact-head execution recovery rather than guessing the hot path.
assignments.conclusion: Exact deterministic 180/500/1000/2000-turn Chromium baseline passed. Full-document assistant-match enumeration scales approximately linearly with retained history; no Send-adjacent events occurred. A2 should falsify a stateless grouped-selector tail collector before considering persistent observer state.

Large-chat benchmark improves according to A1's predeclared discriminating metric without an unacceptable small-chat regression
Newest answer and terminal marker selection remain correct across duplicate/hidden/nested cases
At-most-once Send journal evidence remains at least as strict as before
Generated userscript/extension parity is preserved when product source changes
requiredTests: A1 exact benchmark/correctness fixture before and after
generated parity and full unit suite for product changes
assignments.fallbackWork: If A1 shows no meaningful dominant problem, do not manufacture a product patch. Record no-change evidence and hand A3 the strongest remaining falsification target.
assignments.activationReason: A1 exact baseline submitted with deterministic scaling evidence and a predeclared grouped-selector falsification criterion.

assignments.goal: Attempt to falsify the long-chat optimization or no-change conclusion under adversarial DOM history, mutation churn, stale/hidden duplicates, route changes, and unresolved Send states.
acceptanceCriteria: Stress at least one materially larger history than A1's smallest baseline
Older HALT/PROCEED/CHOICE markers can never override a newer unfinished answer
Hidden and nested duplicate answer nodes do not corrupt newest-answer selection
Mutation churn and DOM replacement do not create runaway observers/timers or stale-node actuation
Route/lease/uncertain-Send behavior remains fail closed with zero duplicate Send
Any performance claim is bound to exact head, fixture size, and raw measurements
requiredTests: repeat benchmark after adversarial mutation load
assignments.fallbackWork: A deterministic failure must create a bounded ready recovery assignment before A4; do not weaken the performance or safety oracle.

assignments.goal: Measure the accepted long-chat path under Pixel-class Chromium emulation and cross-browser constraints without promoting emulation into physical-device certification.
prohibitedActions: claiming physical Android or Firefox-Android certification from Playwright
acceptanceCriteria: Run long-chat fixture under configured Pixel-7 chromium-mobile on exact head
Measure scaling, active intervals/observers, panel count, host composer/latest-message usability, and zero Send-adjacent actuation
Include a desktop Firefox correctness run where the fixture is portable and explicitly distinguish it from GeckoView/Firefox-Android
Compare against the Round-4 180-message mobile reference without claiming identical hardware timing
State whether the chosen approach is practical for lower-end/mobile use based on measured trend and resource accumulation proxies
assignments.fallbackWork: If a browser-specific failure is reproducible, preserve it and create the smallest platform-scoped recovery rather than weakening shared correctness.

acceptanceCriteria: Audit compares raw before/after measurements and verifies the benchmark actually discriminates candidate approaches
No speed claim is accepted from stale-head or unbound CI
Newest-answer and terminal-marker correctness remains intact
Send/CHOICE/route/lease/uncertainty safeguards remain fail closed
Mobile and Firefox limitations are stated precisely
Unsupported performance or hardware claims are rejected rather than rounded up into certification
If the bounded objective is certified, any human review is queued locally and the next independent program remains discoverable under Policy B
